The first thing I looked for was a tri tip.  They only had 3, and they were absolutely massive.  Something that you would buy for a huge party you would host.  But because there weren't any other options, we had to settle with 1/2 a cow.

We got some fresh corn, which was super sweet, and some potatoes, ranch beans and misc other items.  

The store was very clean, and the check out attendants were very pleasant and accommodating for when we were running back and grabbing things during checkout."},{"review_date":"2018-07-24 04:32:54","review_stars":5.0,"review_text":"Best apple fritter I've ever had.
